title: DOW-UAP-D8, Mission Report, Djibouti, 2025
doc_notes: This document is a heavily redacted Department of War Mission Report (MISREP) regarding a UAP sighting in Djibouti on June 15, 2025.

incidents.summary: U.S. military operator observed two round white hot UAPs moving south at 240 knots.
incidents.quote: OBS 2X ROUND WHITE HOT UAPS DYNAMIC SOUTH AT APPROX 240NM/HOUR
